missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should verify that the text entered in the 'tell your experience' field is truncated to a maximum character limit. It should: 1) Retrieve the current text value from the feedback text field using get_entered_text(), 2) Compare the length of the entered text against the expected maximum length (max_length parameter), 3) Verify that if the input text exceeds max_length, the displayed text is truncated to exactly max_length characters, 4) Optionally verify that a character count indicator shows the truncation (e.g., '500/500'), 5) Return True if truncation is correctly applied, False otherwise, 6) Log the comparison results for debugging. The method belongs in feedback.py because it validates behavior specific to the feedback text input field.
